d:
This is all the pics I can find of Nataissue's OC, be it from commissions or fanart, etc. Probably incomplete, a lot of this shit is lost to time due to the harassment surrounding Nataissue at the time, as well as people spurging out about the people who supposedly took the comms.

Almost all comms were anonymous due to the subject matter so it's up to you to decide if some artist really did draw something or if it's just an intentional style imitation, as well as using other's OCs, etc. Posting all I have here so it can survive.

There's a couple of posts here where it's dubious if it's actually Kate or just a similar looking shota, but i'm sure of *almost* all of them and the nature of these posts and them being deleted over time means there's not a concrete way to tell all of the time.

If you know any I missed I beg you to link to it if you can. I want it and i'll probably add it to future revisions/iterations when I find the time.
